sentences.start: Stresses of school life may cause
sentences.full_sentence: Stresses of school life may cause depression to students.
sentences.translation: ضغوط الحياة المدرسية قد تسبب الاكتئاب للطلاب.

sentences.full_sentence: John was playing tennis when he hurt his leg.
sentences.translation: كان جون يلعب التنس عندما أصاب ساقه.

sentences.full_sentence: For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
sentences.translation: لكل فعل رد فعل مساوٍ له في المقدار ومعاكس له في الاتجاه.

sentences.full_sentence: Potatoes turn green when exposed to light.
sentences.translation: البطاطس تتحول إلى اللون الأخضر عندما تتعرض للضوء.

sentences.start: When students are careless of studying
sentences.full_sentence: When students are careless of studying, they will have bad results.
sentences.translation: عندما يكون الطلاب مهملين في الدراسة، سيكون لديهم نتائج سيئة.

sentences.start: If we don't have anything nice to say
sentences.full_sentence: If we don't have anything nice to say, it's better to keep silent.
sentences.translation: إذا لم يكن لدينا شيء جميل لنقوله، فمن الأفضل أن نصمت.

sentences.full_sentence: The teacher was angry because we were talking.
sentences.translation: كان المعلم غاضباً لأننا كنا نتحدث.

sentences.start: People bully by many ways like
sentences.full_sentence: People bully by many ways like hurting feelings.
sentences.translation: يتنمر الناس بطرق عديدة مثل إيذاء المشاعر.

sentences.start: While we were eating the cake
sentences.full_sentence: While we were eating the cake, John came.
sentences.translation: بينما كنا نأكل الكعكة، جاء جون.

sentences.full_sentence: I was driving when somebody hit my car.
sentences.translation: كنت أقود السيارة عندما اصطدم شخص ما بسيارتي.
